Task 06 is the only code task in the batch and has a well-formed anchor with `path::test_name — description` entries plus an explicit red/green loop including a sabotage step.

Task 08 carries `skills: []` and `reviewers: []` with matching prose in the Required Skills and Reviewers sections — consistent, and correct for a maintainer-credentials user action. Project knowledge links point at `overview.md` in place of the template's `project.md`; all five tasks link the real paths and tasks 08 and 10 annotate the substitution explicitly. `architecture.md` is present in all five.
Dependency graph 01←02←03←{04,05,06,07} and 01←08←09←10 is acyclic; every `depends_on` value references an existing task and every task's wave is strictly greater than its dependencies' waves.

Task 10 covers all 13 user-spec acceptance criteria plus a catch-all requiring a verdict with evidence for every user-spec and tech-spec criterion.

No merge or split candidates: the five tasks touch disjoint file sets, and the three-file tasks (07 docs, 09 CI+e2e) are single-outcome — task 09's grouping is mandated by tech-spec Decision 4. Ten tasks against five user stories is not over-decomposition.
